definitions.explanation: The silver-colored coin worth 100 yen, one of the most commonly used coins in everyday transactions.

examples.japanese: {百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二枚|にまい}→二枚：30347_nimai⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put two 100-yen coins into the vending machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{重|おも}かった→重い：00804_omoi⟧。
examples.english: My wallet was heavy because it was full of 100-yen coins.

notes:
Compound of {百円|ひゃくえん} (100 yen) + {玉|だま} (ball, coin). The suffix {玉|だま} forms the names of coins, as in {五百円玉|ごひゃくえんだま} (500-yen coin) and {十円玉|じゅうえんだま} (10-yen coin).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to insert a 100-yen coin
- {百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧: one 100-yen coin
- {百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay with 100-yen coins
